latent.common_scale: one chi-square draw shared across the Gaussian factor vector per sample
latent.shared_scale_scope: all Gaussian factors in one load-input sample share the same chi-square scale

bounded_margins.mean_and_variance: marginal mean zero and variance one for standardized bounded deviation
bounded_margins.Q_model: same signed base QD with its own correlated bounded multiplier; no strict P/Q proportionality

calibration: Validate sample moments, marginal bounds and input correlation before state generation; save actual correlation and seeds.
